added: Shared survey link: an owner can issue one link per survey that participants open to take the survey without a personal code.
Release identity: a cookbook-pinned release record, a build-time version+commit stamp, version fields on health and MCP serverInfo, and a generated changelog.json for the version badge.
changed: Health `build` now reports `<version>+<sha7>` derived from the pinned release record and the build commit instead of a hardcoded literal.
Rate limiter boundaries and OAuth flows hardened for the first DEV collection increment.
fixed: Email-code redemption is atomic; a code cannot be redeemed twice under concurrent requests, and conflict-recovery kinds are distinct.
security: Rate-limited anonymous, code and bearer paths fail closed with RATE_LIMITED; OAuth code redemption is single-use.
